figures.before: Kitchen Gut Renovation Scope: What's Included vs. a Cosmetic Refresh
figures.alt: Kitchen cabinet installation checked for level with clean base cabinets, prepared wall, and protected floor
figures.caption: A true kitchen gut renovation coordinates demolition, layout, structure where needed, rough-ins, cabinets, appliances, ventilation, lighting, counters, finishes, inspections, and the sequence that brings those pieces together.

figures.before: Bath Gut Renovation Scope: When to Go to Studs vs. Surface
figures.alt: Master bathroom shower under construction with continuous waterproofing membrane, recessed niche, drain, and carefully prepared wall framing
figures.caption: A bath taken to the studs creates the opportunity to correct the water-managed assembly, plumbing, electrical work, ventilation, backing, layout, finishes, and details that are hidden once the room is closed.

figures.before: Living in the House During a K&B Renovation
figures.alt: Occupied home renovation with a sealed dust barrier, negative-air equipment, floor protection, and a clean adjacent living area
figures.caption: When residents remain in the house, the construction plan needs protected routes, dust control, temporary utilities, daily cleanup, access, schedule communication, and realistic limits on what can stay operational.
